contentList.content: A constellation of a life-giving goblet appears on you. Whenever you cast a spell using a <LSTag Tooltip="SpellSlot">spell slot</LSTag> that restores <LSTag Tooltip="HitPoints">hit points</LSTag> to a creature, you can cast <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_StarryForm_Chalice_Heal">Chalice Healing</LSTag> until the end of your turn.

In Starry Form. Whenever you cast a spell using a <LSTag Tooltip="SpellSlot">spell slot</LSTag> that restores <LSTag Tooltip="HitPoints">hit points</LSTag> to a creature, you can cast <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_StarryForm_Chalice_Heal">Chalice Healing</LSTag> until the end of your turn.

Alter the terrain around you, allowing nearby allies in the area to travel with ease.

You and your allies aren't affected by Difficult Terrain, can't be Restrained or Paralysed, and gain Resistance to[1].
